newsitem.title: USA: Alba-Waldensian prophylaxis gets FDA okay.
newsitem.headline: Alba-Waldensian prophylaxis gets FDA okay.

text.p: Alba-Waldensian Inc said on Friday it received U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for Pulstar, its compression device used to help prevent deep vein thrombosis.

The company, a diversied manufacturer specializing in medical specialty products, hosiery and intimate apparel, said Pulstar could be used with the PAS pump unit as an intermittent limb compression device to assist in the prevention of deep vein thrombosis, or a blood clot.

The PAS pump is a pulsatile antiembolism system, or a combination of an air pump with a compression stocking which helps prevent blood clots, the company said. Pulstar includes a wrap feature, it said.
